Dear Sandbag Team,

I am writing to apply for the Communications Assistant position at Sandbag. As a junior digital marketer with a strong technical foundation in web design, SEO, and content creation, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your mission of evidence-based climate policy advocacy.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites. My project mirook.com demonstrates my ability to create engaging content and optimize for both traditional and AI-powered search engines. I am proficient in Canva and have experience creating videos and animations, which I believe will be valuable for your campaigns.

I am passionate about fighting climate change and eager to apply my skills to support Sandbag's communications. I am based in Belgium and have the necessary permits to work in the EU.

I have attached my CV and cover letter for your consideration. Thank you for your time.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Sandbag Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Communications Assistant position at Sandbag. As a junior digital marketer with a technical background in web design, SEO, and content creation, I am drawn to Sandbag's mission of using data-driven advocacy to influence EU climate policy. I am passionate about fighting climate change and eager to contribute my skills to make your research more accessible and impactful.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed skills directly relevant to this position. I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted blog content, and build and maintain WordPress websites using Elementor and Astra. I am confident in using Canva for graphic design and have experience creating videos and animations, which I have applied in my own project mirook.com. There, I designed a multi-page site, implemented structured data, and optimized for both traditional and AI-powered search engines, demonstrating my ability to create content that reaches diverse audiences.

I am also experienced in social media coordination and content management, and I am quick to learn new tools. My technical skills include web development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and data visualization, which could support Sandbag's online tools and website. I have a keen interest in EU policy and economics, and I am committed to evidence-based communication.

Based in Belgium, I have the necessary permits to work in the EU and am available to start immediately. I am excited about the opportunity to work in a hybrid format in Brussels or Paris and to collaborate with a dedicated team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to Sandbag's important work.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
